statement: All employees become entitled to 4 weeks of paid annual holidays (annual leave) after 12 months of continuous employment, and an employer must give their employees at least 4 weeks of paid annual holidays.
caveat: The entitlement sits in the Holidays Act 2003 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23) alongside public holidays, sick leave, and the pay-as-you-go option for genuinely casual work, each with its own rules; Holidays Act reform has been under way for several years. Check the live Employment New Zealand guidance before setting leave policy.
